newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on November 26.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on November 26.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on November 26, a central bank official said on Monday.

The central bank is not setting the issue volume of three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month T-bills in advance, the head of the bank's market and exchange department, Vitaly Migashko, told Reuters.
At the last three-month T-bill sale on November 21, the bank sold 84.786 million hryvnias of paper, with an average annualised yield of 56.88 percent. The average price was 87.58 hryvnias.
The bank sold 36.837 million hryvnias worth of six-month T-bills on November 21, with an average annualised yield of 59.90 percent and an average price of 77.00 hryvnias.
Nine-month discount T-bills sold at an average price of 69.58 hryvnias on November 21 at an auction of 174,800 hryvnias of paper with average yields of 58.45 percent.
The bank sold 22,000 hryvnias of 12-month discount T-bills on November 19, with an average annualised yield of 60.94 percent and an average price of 62.20 hryvnias.
